research.title: U.S. Soccer's JT Batson on the World Cup and Scaling the Game
research.summary: U.S. Soccer has entered a transformative era, driving the growth of the sport across the nation as it capitalizes on hosting the 2026 World Cup and other global sporting tournaments to come. JT Batson, CEO and secretary general of U.S. Soccer, joins Dave Dase, head of Goldman Sachs' global sports business, to discuss the legacy of the World Cup, U.S. Soccer’s strategic plans through the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics and the 2031 Women’s World Cup, and how an invigorated grassroots culture could make the U.S. "one of the world's great soccer countries."
